method: Read-only model request history, actual tool_finished records, and installed local Qwen chat-template rendering. No new LLM request or physics experiment.
findings: No evidence of feedback loss, incorrect tool pairing, chat-template mismatch, or application response-cache reuse. This is not a proof that the inference engine has no bugs.
Single-turn tool exclusion cannot stop alternating validate/analyze actions. Required tool choice constrains syntax, not train/validation disjointness.
R11 world_1 received property coverage and validation position/velocity relative RMSE 4.41%/18.96%, but continued the same interpretation.
EOF has next_offset=null and empty content, yet truncated=true because it means not the complete file. This pagination ambiguity may contribute to one loop; it does not explain all failures.
repetition_penalty=1.0, presence/frequency penalties=0, repetition detection unset. These are observed defaults, not established causal bugs.
limitations: Model generation is stochastic; fixed seeds do not establish stable success rates.
Historical tool-pair count repeats prior messages across requests and is not the number of distinct tool executions.
